The record sits at coordinates in Italy, 18.7 miles from Parma Airport, and carries no city or state label.

For AI specifically, this tells nothing about capacity. There is no megawatt figure, no operator, no confirmation that the site exists as a functioning facility rather than a map entry. A hosting business of this apparent type would serve websites and domains, not model training, and the data offers no basis for connecting it to the compute supply chain.

What the data does not cover is nearly everything that would matter: scale, ownership, operating status, and whether the tag reflects a real facility at all. The research note states that confirmation failed because search quota ran out, not because the business was found to be absent. Treat this as an unresolved map point, not a data center.
